title: Decision (robot-domain-rules/3)
description: The answer, with its working. SPEC.md § Decision.

reasons.description: The checks at the strictest status, in trace order. The ruleId `rulebook_version` (not in the rulebook's builtin list) means the rulebook itself was refused: another format, never reinterpreted.

limits.description: Effective limits (MIN across matching limit rules). Present only when status is ALLOW or LIMIT and a limit rule matched.

then.description: A deny rule's `instead` hint. Present only when status is BLOCK.

approvalRequests.description: Present only when status is PAUSE and at least one approval wait is unmet.

approvalsUsed.description: Present only when status is ALLOW or LIMIT and a signed approval cleared a wait: the instances to record as consumed.

trace.description: Every check that ran, in order.

fingerprint.description: The rulebook's fingerprint (64 hex). When the rulebook itself was refused by version (reason rulebook_version) it is the fingerprint string the refused rulebook claimed, or empty.
